The test image shows a leaf with scattered, whitish, roughly circular lesions on its upper surface. These symptoms are classic for a fungal disease that grows superficially. Comparing with the possible classes, Anthracnose and Sooty Mould are unlikely due to the color of the spots (typically dark brown/black and black, respectively). Die Back primarily affects stems. Powdery Mildew is characterized by white, powdery fungal spots, which closely matches the test image. The reference image for Powdery Mildew confirms this, showing similar white to grayish patches on the leaf.
